name: OpenBao / Vault secrets
description: Optional. Installs the OpenBao CLI and 'secrets-gh-login', which logs gh in with a GitHub token read from an OpenBao/Vault server you configure via environment variables, using OIDC device-code sign-in with a refresh token shared by all devcontainers. Nothing is configured by default.

version.description: OpenBao release to install (without the leading 'v').
